adjudication: LLM-assisted manual review against user turns and saved stage outputs, snapshots and retrieval. No keyword-based semantic classifier and no independent blinded human adjudication.
rules: Gold is never passed to the engine. Freeze conversations, expectations and source before live execution; preserve failures without tuning during the run.
Judge meaning, not exact names, field wording or language. Apply explicit entity-layout and naming requirements below separately from fact recall.

Inspect every current and historical value item, including extra claims, and entity names/aliases. Record source turns, fact UUIDs and snapshot references for supported, wrong or unresolved judgments.
Score missing required meanings even when processing errors or abstains. Report operational failures separately.
An employer retained alongside explicit ending text does not assert that the job is active. Real changes preserve the previous value inside the same fact; unrelated facts and identities must survive.
Record wrong fact-value propositions separately from stale or misleading identity metadata. Do not hide either behind successful execution.
Review query-relevant retrieval separately from background context and storage. Entity names alone are not answers to factual queries.

A run passes this pilot only if required meanings, structural requirements and retrieval checks pass with no observed wrong memory or unresolved judgments. Repeated-attribute coverage is reported separately, not silently inferred from a semantic pass.

Weighted fact error units = 5 * wrong fact-value propositions + missed required meanings. Structural/naming failures are separate counts. This is not an accuracy percentage or validated utility metric.

required: The user still works as a doctor at Harbour Hospital.
The hospital work is on weekdays.
The user formerly worked as a lecturer at Northbridge College.
The college work was on Saturdays and has ended.
structure: The initial memory has two independently identifiable job entities, one for each user job; it does not bundle both jobs into a single My jobs entity.
Both job entities retain their UUIDs after the update; ending the college job does not end, replace or move the hospital job.
The ended college employment retains its fact UUID and archives its previous value in that fact; its current value clearly describes the ending.
No unsupported hospital/college organization entities are invented merely to hold job details.
retrieval: Returned memory clearly distinguishes the user's continuing hospital job from the ended college job.
forbidden_examples: The college lecturer role remains active.
The doctor job is at Northbridge College.

required: Daniel still works as a doctor at Willow Hospital.
Daniel's hospital work is on weekdays.
Daniel formerly worked as a lecturer at Birch College.
Daniel's college work was on Saturdays and has ended.
structure: Daniel is one person entity containing both separately identifiable employment facts; no independent job, hospital or college entity is created solely to describe him.
Daniel's entity UUID and both employment fact UUIDs survive the update; only the intended employment changes meaning.
The ended college employment archives its previous value inside the same fact, while the hospital employment remains current.
coverage_checks: Record whether both employment facts use exactly the same attribute_name. If they do not, mark repeated-attribute live coverage as not exercised even if their meanings are correct.
retrieval: Returned memory keeps both employments on Daniel and distinguishes his continuing hospital job from his ended college job.
forbidden_examples: Daniel is still lecturing at Birch College.

required: The user owns a Honda Civic.
structure: The initial car entity uses a durable supported name or label; mutable blue colour is not baked into its canonical name or saved as a permanent alias without an established nickname.
The same car entity UUID and canonical name survive repainting; the current returned identity metadata does not describe the car as still blue.
The colour change retains the relevant fact UUID and preserves blue in that fact's history, with white current.
No duplicate car entity is created to represent repainting.
retrieval: Returned memory gives white as current colour, blue as previous colour and 2021 as purchase year, with a consistent stable entity name.
forbidden_examples: Blue is still the current colour.
The user bought another Honda when repainting.
The car was purchased in an invented precise month or day.
